_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Normal send waits for its delayed new-conversation draft without following later navigation. The test seeded a conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The server's answer to the browser's draft creation (POST /api/conversations/draft) is held back until call "releaseDraft"; call "draftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created the draft and, once it has, sets {{DRAFT}} to its conversation ID; call "draftAnswered" says whether the browser has received the answer. Message submissions (POST /api/conversation/<id>/chat) reach the server; call "chats" counts them, and call "submissions" lists them as JSON, each with its URL path and message. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Fill the message input with "Send this message to the draft that created it.".
2. Call "draftCreated" until it returns "true".
3. Click [data-testid="send-button"].
4. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text").
5. Call "releaseDraft". Call "chats" should return "1".
6. Call "submissions" must return exactly [{"path":"/api/conversation/{{DRAFT}}/chat","message":"Send this message to the draft that created it."}].
7. The URL should still have exactly the path "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text").
8. Eval "localStorage.getItem('shelley-draft:{{DRAFT}}') === null" should become true.
9. Select conversation {{DRAFT}} from the drawer. The message input should have the value "" (empty).

steps.value: Send this message to the draft that created it.
